title: The Twelfth
summary: Billy invites Paddy to watch the Twelfth parade, but Paddy's well-meaning ignorance leads to a series of cultural faux pas that horrify his Protestant neighbor.

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot of Billy and Paddy facing each other over the fence. Billy holds a small Orange Order sash, looking proud. Morning sunlight creates warm shadows between the houses.

dialogue.line: Fancy watching the Twelfth with me?

scenes.visual: Close-up on Paddy's face showing genuine enthusiasm and nodding eagerly. His eyes light up with curiosity about the cultural exchange.
Wide shot of a street lined with Orange banners and bunting. Camera slowly pans across the decorated street as Billy and Paddy walk into frame from the right.
scenes.narration: The annual Orange Order parade approaches.

scenes.visual: Medium two-shot of Paddy and Billy standing among the crowd. Paddy pulls out his phone and starts taking photos enthusiastically while Billy watches nervously.
Extreme close-up on Billy's face showing pure horror and panic. His eyes widen as he realizes what's happening.
Medium shot of Paddy cheerfully waving at the passing parade participants. He cups his hands around his mouth to shout, completely oblivious to protocol.
Quick shot of Billy grabbing Paddy's arm and trying to pull him back. Billy's face shows desperate embarrassment.
Medium shot of Paddy clapping enthusiastically along to the drumbeat, completely out of rhythm. He bobs his head with genuine enjoyment.
Extreme close-up on Billy covering his face with both hands in complete mortification. Camera holds static on his gesture of despair.
Wide shot of both men back at their fence with steaming mugs of tea. Paddy looks confused while Billy shakes his head slowly. Late afternoon shadows fall across both gardens.
